question: Which of the following is NOT one of the characteristics of the new agricultural strategy?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Use of organic manures.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The use of organic manures is **not** one of the characteristics of the new agricultural strategy.
 
• The following are the **characteristics** of the new agricultural strategy:
 
• **Use of chemical fertilisers:**
 
 
• The new agricultural strategy promotes the use of chemical fertilisers to **increase crop yield and improve soil fertility.**
 
• Chemical fertilisers provide **essential nutrients** to plants and help in their growth and development.
 
 
 
• **Use of hybrid seeds:**
 
 
• The new agricultural strategy emphasizes the use of hybrid seeds that are genetically engineered to **resist pests and diseases, tolerate adverse weather conditions, and enhance crop yield.**
 
 
 
• **Extensive irrigation:**
 
 
• The new agricultural strategy encourages the adoption of** extensive irrigation techniques **to ensure the availability of water for crops throughout the year.
 
• Irrigation helps in reducing the dependence on rainfall and mitigating the** impact of droughts.**
 
 
 
• **Mechanization:**
 
 
• The new agricultural strategy promotes the use of** modern farm machinery and equipment **that can perform various farm operations efficiently and effectively.
 
• Mechanization helps in reducing the** labor requirement and increasing productivity.**
 
 
 
• **Use of organic manures:**
 
 
• Organic manures are **natural fertilizers** that are derived from plant and animal sources.
 
• They are rich in** nutrients** and help in improving **soil health and fertility.**
 
• However, the new agricultural strategy does not emphasize the use of organic manures as they are** not **as effective as chemical fertilisers in increasing crop yield and productivity.
 
 
 
• **Use of chemical pesticides:**
 
 
• **​** The new agricultural strategy also promotes the use of chemical pesticides to **control pests and diseases** that can damage crops and reduce yield.
 
• However, excessive use of chemical pesticides can lead to **environmental pollution and health hazards. **
 
• Therefore, the new agricultural strategy emphasizes the judicious use of chemical pesticides and encourages the adoption of **integrated pest management practices.**
